verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a keyless JSON API for business-entity data, served from the Socrata open-data platform (data.colorado.gov) rather than from the registry itself. That gives programmatic read access that roughly parallels the UI's business database search. The UI's transactional functions have no API evidence: entity formation and foreign filings, name reservation, conversions, trademark registration, periodic reports, certificates of good standing, and registered-agent changes all appear only as web forms or PDFs. Missing for 10: API endpoints for filing and other write actions, API access to certificates and periodic reports, and first-party registry API documentation showing UI parity.
